high_level_description: This image appears to be a selfie taken by a person standing in front of an ornate mirror with a decorative frame. The individual is wearing a black sleeveless jumpsuit and has long, wavy hair. They are holding a camera in their left hand and a phone in their right hand, taking the photo. The person is also wearing a necklace and multiple bracelets on their right wrist. The background shows a room with a bed that has white bedding and a patterned throw. There is a black bag slung over the person's shoulder.
